ios.desc:
Binsoo: Photo Filters & Editor
Discover Binsoo, the powerful and easy-to-use photo editing app that transforms ordinary photos into stunning works of art. Designed exclusively for iPhone, Binsoo brings a suite of professional editing tools right to your fingertips.

Key Features:
Premium Filters: Over 100 unique filters crafted by experts, making it easy to create photos with distinctive styles.
Professional Editing Tools: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and many other parameters with just a few taps.
Creative Effects: Add special effects like blurring to make your photos more impressive.
Recipe Sharing: Create and share your unique photo editing recipes with the Binsoo community, and discover recipes from other users to keep your creativity flowing.
Easy Sharing: Share your best photos on social media in just a few seconds.
Why Choose Binsoo?
Binsoo is not just a photo editing app; it's a reliable companion on your creative journey. With its user-friendly interface, Binsoo is perfect for both beginners and professional photographers.

Subscription Info:
Subscribe for unlimited access to all features and content offered for purchase within the app.
Subscription options: $1.99 per month, $14.99 per year

Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Download Binsoo today and start your creative journey!

quotes.text:
Hello there, Hackers!

I'm excited to share with you a project that came to life during my journey into SwiftUI: Binsoo. With five years of experience as a React Native Developer, last July presented me with a crossroads. Embracing unemployment as an opportunity, I plunged into the captivating realm of SwiftUI.
I'm hoping to receive feedback and reviews from all of you so that I can continue to maintain and further develop the project.

Link Download: https://apps.apple.com/vn/app/binsoo-photo-editor/id6502683720
